answer: Because the vertex stake is held until the nectar settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the knoll audit lists each exposure. A farm running 165 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. An attester must stake 7% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
